description: Source code for the NtlmBufferReader class, which provides methods to read and parse NTLM buffer data, including security buffers, target info, message types, and signature matching.

classes.name: NtlmBufferReader
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing NTLM protocol buffers, including security buffers, target info, and message headers.

methods.name: CanRead
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of bytes can be read from the current cursor position.

methods.name: CanReadFrom
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of bytes can be read from a given offset.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadFlags
methods.description: Reads negotiate flags as a 32-bit unsigned integer and casts to NegotiateFlags.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a span of bytes into the provided buffer.

methods.name: ReadBytesFrom
methods.description: Reads bytes from a SecurityBuffer into the provided buffer.

methods.name: ReadPayloadAsBufferReader
methods.description: Creates a new NtlmBufferReader for a payload specified by a SecurityBuffer.

methods.name: ReadSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Reads a SecurityBuffer structure from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadAvPairHeader
methods.description: Reads an AV pair header, extracting the AV ID and length.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfo
methods.description: Reads target info AV pairs from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfoPayload
methods.description: Reads target info payload AV pairs.

methods.name: ReadMessageType
methods.description: Reads and validates the message type.

methods.name: SkipSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Skips over a security buffer.

methods.name: SkipSecurityBufferWithValidation
methods.description: Reads and validates a security buffer, then skips it.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: MatchSignature
methods.description: Checks if the buffer matches the NTLM signature.

methods.name: MatchMessageType
methods.description: Checks if the message type matches the expected type.

methods.name: MatchMessageHeader
methods.description: Checks if the buffer matches the signature and message type.

methods.name: MatchZeros
methods.description: Checks if a sequence of bytes are all zeros.

methods.name: MatchEmptySecurityBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the security buffer is empty.

methods.name: ReadUInt
methods.description: Template method to read an unsigned integer of any type.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets the current cursor position within the buffer.
